title: suregada lithoxyla
intro: Suregada lithoxyla, commonly known as the False Cordia, is a plant species within the family Euphorbiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including treating fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Suregada lithoxyla are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may be beneficial in reducing pain, fighting off infections, and protecting against cell damage. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
